title: The 0587 queue, worked: what landed, what fell, and what the survey got wrong
decision: coordination record retained; the ranked queue in HOTSPOTS.md refreshed; no production change of its own
code_state: this record modifies only documentation; the wave's production changes are the records 0588-0631 it closes, each merged with its own commit
reason_codes: every number quoted is the measuring record's own, with that record's tier and floor; nothing is re-measured or aggregated here
the wave worked every item of change 0587's 36-item queue to an outcome: landed with a paired measurement, frozen as a design, or declined or falsified on measurement
the survey's own errors that the wave exposed are annotated in the 0587 record beside the items they correct, and are listed here

the queue that remains is a set of prerequisites (human decisions on contracts, two proposed ADRs, missing infrastructure) rather than a set of optimizations, and is stated with the record that priced each

accepted_evidence.per_change_records: records 0588 to 0631 with their packets under results/change-NNNN/, each with its own before and after measurements, oracles and gates
accepted_evidence.integration_gates: fmt, clippy and test for the fourteen in-scope crates on the merged head mid-wave (1946b964e) and on the final head (8b07b45dc): clean, clean, and 436 test binaries all passing
accepted_evidence.merge_log: the wave's commits on the main branch bound to their branch commits by cherry-pick trailers

accepted_costs.merge_method: each branch was cherry-picked onto the main branch in completion order and amended with its log sections; branch commits are retained for traceability
accepted_costs.host_contention: up to eight agents built and measured on one host at once, so each record's timing floor is its own and several rest on counts
accepted_costs.usage_caps: two session usage caps terminated seven and then eight agents mid-work; each was resumed from its transcript and worktree; no evidence was lost, and several records were finished in two sittings
accepted_costs.gate_scope: the integration gates ran with default features and do not reach the harness's own suite or the facade's feature-gated tests (0619, 0629)

known_gaps.still_required_by_the_goal: cold-cache and physical-device distributions, a real range source, peak RSS for read paths, concurrency scaling with a reachable parallel path, cross-platform confirmation, coverage-guided fuzzing
known_gaps.decisions_pending: the original-bytes compactness contract at publication (0602, 0613), proposed ADRs 0030 and 0031, the OLE2 sector-layout policy (0617), the reader that owns a lazily loaded payload's refusal (0597), the DOCX whitespace-compaction question (0591)
known_gaps.not_re_verified: the coordinator did not re-run any agent's measurement, oracle or differential

withheld: any aggregate, geometric mean or program-level speedup across the wave; every claim stays scoped to the record that made it

provenance.host: AMD EPYC 9R45, 32 cores, 123 GiB, Linux 7.0.0-1012-aws, rustc 1.95.0
